title: script
description: Output of the reel-script agent. Words only - no visual, camera, graphic or timing direction lives here.

takeaway.description: The one thing a viewer can now do that they could not before. If you cannot write this sentence, the script has no reason to exist.

self_check.description: The agent's own audit, written before it hands the script over. Present so failures are visible rather than silent.
